compiled_state.title: GREEN: Rebuild all 10 reviewer agent files with NOT-flag rules via build-review-agents.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD3: All 10 generated reviewer agent files rebuilt via build-review-agents.sh and each contains NOT-flag rubric text

## Implementation Steps

1. Run build-review-agents.sh from repo root:
```bash
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
bash "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh"
```

2. Verify all 10 files contain the NOT-flag heading:
```bash
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
for f in "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents"/code-reviewer-*.md; do
    grep -q '^## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules' "$f" || { echo "MISSING: $f"; exit 1; }
done
echo "ALL OK"
```

3. Verify no unresolved tokens:
```bash
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
grep -rn '{{[A-Z_]*}}' "$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md" && echo 'WARNING: unresolved tokens' || echo 'OK'
```

4. Run test suite to verify test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading now passes:
```bash
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh" 2>&1 | grep 'test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading'
```

NOTE: This worktree may branch from a commit before T3 added the NOT-flag section to reviewer-base.md. If reviewer-base.md in this worktree does not contain `## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules`, check out reviewer-base.md from the session branch before running build-review-agents.sh:
```bash
git show worktree-20260503-125532:plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md > plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
# Also check out reviewer-delta-test-quality.md if it was modified:
git show worktree-20260503-125532:plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-test-quality.md > plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-test-quality.md
```
Then rebuild.

Stage all modified agent files (10 files). Do NOT commit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] build-review-agents.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh; echo "exit: $?"
- [ ] All 10 agent files contain NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules heading
  Verify: for f in plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md; do grep -q '^## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules' "$f" || { echo "MISSING: $f"; exit 1; }; done && echo OK
- [ ] No unresolved substitution tokens
  Verify: grep -rn '{{[A-Z_]*}}' plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md && exit 1 || echo OK
- [ ] test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading passes in test suite
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh 2>&1 | grep 'test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading' | grep -q 'PASS'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
